title: Smart Nutrition Intelligence System (SNIS)
summary: AI-powered healthcare and nutrition platform providing personalized meal recommendations and dietary analytics.
problem: Generic diet plans fail to account for individual health profiles, leading to poor dietary compliance and suboptimal health outcomes.
solution: Designed an intelligent recommendation engine analyzing user metrics and dietary restrictions to deliver data-driven nutritional guidance.
features: Personalized dietary recommendation algorithm based on user health parameters
Nutritional breakdown visualization and macro-nutrient balance tracking
User health metric profiling and goal tracking dashboard
